item.title: Implement retry budget scheduling and edge case tests
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py exactly according to SPEC.md, preserve the documented public API, and add focused tests extending test_retry_budget.py beyond its basics. Cover validation of every argument (including validation before early returns; reject bools/floats and invalid ranges), attempt exhaustion semantics, huge attempts with efficient saturation, zero base/cap, base greater than cap, Retry-After floor unaffected by cap, and the strict elapsed + delay < budget boundary including zero waits. Use only the Python standard library. Run the focused tests and any relevant existing checks; commit the completed work. Acceptance: all specified valid cases return the documented int or None, invalid inputs raise ValueError, tests pass, and changes are committed.

pr.body: Implemented the public retry_delay API using built-in integer validation before any early return, efficient backoff saturation, uncapped Retry-After minimums, and the strict elapsed plus delay budget boundary. Expanded test_retry_budget.py for argument validation, exhaustion, very large attempts, zero and inverted limits, retry floors, and the saturation boundary. Checks: focused unittest and unittest discovery both pass (12 tests); git diff --check passes. Standard library only.
pr.summary: Implemented validated retry scheduling with capped exponential backoff and budget-aware waits. Before: retry_delay was unimplemented. Now: valid inputs produce a delay or None, with edge cases covered by tests.
